newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- ABN AMRO and ING calls sought on EOE.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- ABN AMRO and ING calls sought on EOE.

text.p: Gains for the underlying shares were accompanied by active trade in calls for ABN AMRO and ING on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Monday.
Shares of financial groups ABN AMRO and ING were buoyed by firmer bonds. ABN AMRO gained 1.50 guilders at 101.00 -- its first close above 100.00 while ING was up one guilder at 57.20.
Options dealers reported fair interest for calls in the underlying shares on the EOE, where ABN AMRO options accounted for 10.3 percent of overall business and ING 11.04 percent.

"There was some buying of calls and buying of long-term options with selling of short-term strangles. People were setting up synthetic stock positions and writing some out-of- the-money calls," a dealer said.
